query_original: What is the FIA's definition of 'Sprint' in the F1 Regulations?
query_reformulada: What is the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA) definition of 'Sprint' as per Article 27.2 of the Formula One Technical and Sporting Regulations?
resposta: According to Article 27.2 of the Formula One Technical and Sporting Regulations, "Sprint" means an FIA Formula One sprint, including sprint qualifying events, as described further in the Sporting Regulations.
